title: ECR-MWM state factor vocabulary
description: Joint state factors Z=(V,F,A,B,C,Q). Version 0.1.0. Labels are evidence annotations, not direct measurements of hidden mental states.

V.description: Objective goal validity, independent of what the person knows.

F.description: Objective feasibility: tools, resources, permissions, and dependencies.

A.description: Evidence label for person access to the key event. Access does not imply understanding.

B.description: The person's subjective belief about goal validity. Never copy directly from V.

C.description: The person's commitment to the original goal.

Q.description: The step the person believes is the next incomplete step, or UNKNOWN / NOT_APPLICABLE.
